# Chart of Accounts

Part of the **Accounts** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List accounts

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/accounts`

Retrieve a paginated list of accounts with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: currency, creator, taxes, tags, journals, moveLines, companies | `currency` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by account name (partial match) |  |
| `filter[code]` | string | No | Filter by account code (partial match) |  |
| `filter[account_type]` | string | No | Filter by account type |  |
| `filter[currency_id]` | integer | No | Filter by currency ID |  |
| `filter[deprecated]` | boolean | No | Filter by deprecated status |  |
| `filter[reconcile]` | boolean | No | Filter by reconcile flag |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `code` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/accounts?include=currency&sort=code&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/accounts?include=currency&sort=code&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/accounts?include=currency&sort=code&page=1', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

print(data)

## Create account

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/accounts`

Create a new account

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Account name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `code` | string | Yes | Account code. Must not be greater than 64 characters. |
| `account_type` | string | Yes | Account type. |
| `currency_id` | integer | No | Currency ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `note` | string | No | Account notes. |
| `deprecated` | boolean | No | Mark account as deprecated. |
| `reconcile` | boolean | No | Enable reconciliation. |
| `non_trade` | boolean | No | Non-trade account flag. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/accounts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "Cash and Bank",
  "code": "1000",
  "account_type": "asset_receivable",
  "currency_id": 1,
  "note": "Primary cash account",
  "deprecated": false,
  "reconcile": true,
  "non_trade": false
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/accounts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "name": "Cash and Bank",
  "code": "1000",
  "account_type": "asset_receivable",
  "currency_id": 1,
  "note": "Primary cash account",
  "deprecated": false,
  "reconcile": true,
  "non_trade": false
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/accounts', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
    'json' => [
    'name' => 'Cash and Bank',
    'code' => '1000',
    'account_type' => 'asset_receivable',
    'currency_id' => 1,
    'note' => 'Primary cash account',
    'deprecated' => false,
    'reconcile' => true,
    'non_trade' => false,
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/accounts"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

payload = {
    "name": "Cash and Bank",
    "code": "1000",
    "account_type": "asset_receivable",
    "currency_id": 1,
    "note": "Primary cash account",
    "deprecated": False,
    "reconcile": True,
    "non_trade": False,
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```
